title: The New Human Standing Canon v0.2 — Standing Surface with Strong Entity Relations
creator: Lee Sharks · Johannes Sigil · Rebekah Cranes
description:
The v0.2 standing registry of the New Human canon, authored by Lee Sharks, Johannes Sigil, and Rebekah Cranes. It gathers figures, texts, lineages, and entities declared into the canon through Effective Acts between October 2025 and June 2026 and expands the earlier list into a relational graph.

For each entry, the registry records operative function, works inducted by extension, predecessors, successors, peers, adjacent inherited-canon references, Canonical Anchoring Protocol relations, and corpus operations. It distinguishes formal New Human induction from influential figures used as references without a canonical-inclusion act. The document is an internal standing surface and graph specification, not an empirical study or external scholarly canon.
